name: Sign in and load private project workspace
covers: Security Vault is the initial workspace view
description: Verifies the signed-in workspace displays the project panels and labels initial status data as a snapshot.
steps: Sign in using the AppDeploy authentication flow
Verify the Security Vault is the initial selected workspace section
Verify the assigned keeper identity is The Archivist and the encrypted vault setup or unlock form appears
Navigate to Overview and confirm the rest of the workspace remains available
Inspect the project cards and integration notice
expected: The workspace opens directly to Security Vault after sign-in, identifies The Archivist as the assigned keeper, presents vault setup or unlock controls, and preserves navigation to the other workspace sections.

name: Create, complete, and retain a workspace task
description: Verifies a signed-in user can create a task, mark it complete, and see the saved state after navigating away and returning.
steps: Open Tasks
Create a task titled 'Upload missing game artwork'
Mark the task complete
Navigate to Overview
Return to Tasks
expected: The task remains present and marked complete after navigation because it is saved in the authenticated user workspace.

name: Reject empty task and protect task API
description: Verifies empty task input is not submitted and task API routes reject requests without a valid sign-in token.
steps: Open Tasks on a mobile viewport
Leave the task title empty
Verify the Add task button is disabled
Attempt to request the task endpoint without signing in
expected: The empty task cannot be submitted and the backend rejects unauthenticated requests without returning private task data.

name: Open the project link launchpad and verify beta status labels
description: Verifies Studio HQ provides one launchpad for project websites and their source/design resources while distinguishing deployed destinations from unverified beta links.
steps: Sign in to Studio HQ
Open Links & Launches from the sidebar
Verify FernAlibi and Hollow House previews are listed with asset warnings
Verify the Pocketwise AppDeploy beta is listed as ready while GitHub Pages remains pending
Verify repository, Pages settings, Actions, Figma and AppDeploy console links are listed
Open Security Vault from the sidebar.
Create a test passphrase of at least 12 characters and confirm it.
Seal the current workspace snapshot and download its encrypted archive.
Lock the vault and verify an incorrect keeper identity is rejected.
Unlock as The Archivist with the correct passphrase, import the encrypted archive and confirm it opens in read-only preview.
expected: The launchpad shows current app URLs and associated source/management links. Pocketwise AppDeploy is marked ready while GitHub Pages remains unverified. The Security Vault requires the assigned keeper identity and passphrase, supports encrypted snapshot export/import, and leaves live tasks unchanged when an archive is imported.

name: Open Pocketwise inside Studio HQ and use the standalone fallback
description: Verifies the user can reach Pocketwise from Studio HQ, see the embedded tracker and open the separately deployed tracker when iframe rendering is unavailable.
steps: Sign in and select Pocketwise from the sidebar
Verify the expense-tracker panel and browser-local data notice appear
Use Open in new tab to open the standalone beta
expected: Studio HQ displays the embedded Pocketwise beta with an obvious standalone fallback and clearly discloses browser-local storage and the absence of cloud sync.
